comment: Cartridge revisions this project knows how to build. A ROM is identified by hash, never by filename, so a renamed or wrong-region dump is rejected rather than half-built.
note_on_sha256: sha256 is null where this project has verified a dump by SHA-1 only. tools/verify.py matches on whichever digests are present and prints both for any ROM it does not recognise, so an unknown revision is one copy-paste away from being supported.
